race.comment: ETERNAL ROMANCE (2) is third-up here on the quick turnaround, missing by 0.7L at Bunbury last time out. Faithfull remains in the irons and drawing away from the fence may be best for her now. Sticks at this trip but rates highly on her recent efforts and can get the job done. SIDE SHOW (12) comes back in trip slightly after a disappointing effort at Belmont last time out. Galati reunites with him after a good run here two back and he's got two wins when aboard. Can play a leading role. SHOOT TO FAME (11) sat handy and was in the race for a long way at Kalgoorlie last time out when only 1.9L off the winner. Maps for a similar run here with Watson replacing the apprentice. Key chance. HANAFUBUKI (1) comes to WA after racing for the Busuttin & Young team. She comes into this without a trial, but the booking of Chris Parnham is a positive sign and he won't be far away. GONDRINKIN (5) is next best stepping back up in trip.
